After School at Cannon School
Cannon School (JrK-12) - Concord, NC - Parent-Facing Deep Research Report
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Prepared July 2026. Hours, ages, fees, and
registration details change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
Executive Summary
Cannon provides after-school coverage for JrK-8 families through its After School Program (care plus
enriching activities like sports, art, cooking, and garden/nature time) and a separate Beyond the Bell
enrichment track, with Camp Cannon extending into summer. It is a family-support offering integrated
with Cannon's broader "adaptive experts" philosophy rather than a bare aftercare room.
Strengths
• Broad activity mix (homework, sports, art, cooking, nature/garden).
• Dedicated enrichment staffing and a distinct Beyond the Bell program.
• Clear single point of contact and portal-based registration.
Questions to Confirm on a Visit
• Daily hours and latest pickup time; late-pickup policy.
• Cost structure (drop-in vs. contracted; sibling pricing).
• Beyond the Bell class catalog, session lengths, and additional fees.
• Whether upper-school students have any supervised after-school option.
Caveats
Based on Cannon's public After School pages (2025-26). Hours, ages, and fees change; verify current
specifics with the school (see Sources).
Sources & Where to Verify
After School Program: https://www.cannonschool.org/cannon-life/after-school-program
Beyond the Bell Enrichment Program: https://www.cannonschool.org/cannon-life/beyond-the-bell-enrichment-program
Camp Cannon (summer): https://www.cannonschool.org/cannon-life/camp-cannon
Contact: afterschool@cannonschool.org; Family Portal (Veracross).

---

After School Pricing at Cannon School
Cannon School (JrK-12) - Concord, NC - After-School Program Pricing (checked July 2026)
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Deep web research performed July 22, 2026; the no-published-pricing finding below was re-verified 3-0 against the live school pages by independent verification agents. Hours, ages, and fees change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
Pricing by Grade & Days per Week
Cannon does not publish after-school pricing. The After School Program serves grades JrK-8 with care until 6:00 p.m., but no day-per-week rates, drop-in rates, or late-pickup fees appear on the public program page or the tuition-and-fees page, and no third-party source publishes Cannon's rates. Families are directed to afterschool@cannonschool.org or the Family Portal (Veracross) for cost details.

| Program | Grades served | Hours | Published cost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| After School Program | JrK-8 | Until 6:00 pm | Not published - contact school |

Notes & Gaps
• Rates exist only behind the Family Portal or via afterschool@cannonschool.org; a direct inquiry to the school is required to obtain them.
• Verified against the live program and tuition pages on July 22, 2026 - zero dollar figures on either.
• Contact for rates: afterschool@cannonschool.org, or the Family Portal (Veracross).
Sources & Where to Verify
After School Program: https://www.cannonschool.org/cannon-life/after-school-program
Tuition and fees: https://www.cannonschool.org/admission/tuition-and-fees

Cannon School - After School Details
Cannon School (JrK-12) - Concord, NC - Care & Activities
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Prepared July 2026. Hours, ages, fees, and
registration details change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
Ages & Setting
ASP is open to students in grades JrK through 8. Students are supervised in a nurturing environment
designed to enhance academic and social skills.
Daily Activities
• Homework help
• Sports / active play
• Art activities
• Cooking
• Nature and garden exploration
Enrichment: Beyond the Bell
In addition to ASP care, Cannon offers the Beyond the Bell Enrichment Program - structured
enrichment classes. Specific class lists, days, and fees are published to families; confirm current
offerings via the Family Portal or the Beyond the Bell page (see Sources).
Logistics & Contact
• Enroll / get info: afterschool@cannonschool.org or the Veracross Family Portal.
• Enrichment Programs Assistant Director: Jordan Lauher.
• Confirm hours, end-of-day pickup, and pricing directly with the school.

After School at Cannon School
Cannon School (JrK-12) - Concord, NC - Program Overview
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Prepared July 2026. Hours, ages, fees, and
registration details change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
At a Glance
Cannon's After School Program (ASP) serves students in grades JrK-8, providing a safe, nurturing
environment after the academic day. A separate Beyond the Bell Enrichment Program adds
structured enrichment offerings, and Camp Cannon covers the summer.
The program is overseen within Cannon Life; Jordan Lauher serves as Enrichment Programs Assistant
Director. Registration and details are handled via the Family Portal (Veracross) or
afterschool@cannonschool.org.
What Students Do
• Homework assistance in a supervised setting.
• Sports and active play.
• Art activities and cooking.
• Nature exploration, including cultivating and observing the school garden.
Philosophy
Cannon frames ASP as an extension of its "adaptive experts" mission - partnering with families,
community, faculty, and staff so that experiences foster each child's individual, developmental, social,
and emotional needs.
Sources & Where to Verify

Beyond the Bell Enrichment Program: https://www.cannonschool.org/cannon-life/beyond-the-bell-enrichment-program
Camp Cannon (summer): https://www.cannonschool.org/cannon-life/camp-cannon
Contact: afterschool@cannonschool.org; Family Portal (Veracross).
